experience.title: R&D Project Engineer
experience.description: Developed and tested machine-vision applications for industrial quality control using classification, object detection and segmentation. Built a golf-ball QC station on Raspberry Pi 5 with a Vision Transformer model, interfaced 24 V industrial sensing to 3.3 V GPIO through optical and relay isolation, and integrated vision systems with Siemens S7-1200 / S7-300 / S7-200 PLCs via TIA Portal. Prepared technical manuals covering dataset creation, model training, GUI deployment and hardware wiring.

education.school: Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation (APU)
education.description: Final year project: a self-supervised Vision Transformer for PCB defect detection reaching 77.50% test accuracy and 37.25 FPS after GPU optimisation. Coursework spanned power flow analysis, overcurrent relay coordination, PLC automation, embedded systems, computer vision and AI.
